title: connector describe_attachment request, v0
description: POST /v0/contributions/connector/describe_attachment, since Plugin API 0.4. The core asks for the exact size and SHA-256 of one attachment of an item it has not accepted yet, before it issues an upload grant. The plugin reads the bytes from the source, at most attachments.max_bytes, or answers a skip.

invocation_id.description: Unique per attempt; correlate logs with it.

configuration.description: The plugin configuration the installer supplies, valid against configuration.schema.

credential.description: The decrypted Deposited Credential, or null for a kind without one. Never log, echo or persist it.

now.description: The core's clock for this invocation (RFC 3339, UTC).

item.description: The item the attachment belongs to, as the plugin returned it.

attachment.description: The attachment descriptor, as the plugin returned it.
